cross_sprint_flows_covered: S2 (M-002 Inward) → V2 (M-009 Inward Report → M-010 Export)
notes: V2 introduces four new modules with cross-sprint dependencies. Per-module HTTP behaviour is already covered by the /ases-test-impl V2 integration suite (tests/integration/v2/). These scenarios focus on multi-endpoint / multi-module flows that no single test_case_ref exercises.

All V2 endpoints require authentication per DS-025. Scenarios that exercise V1 endpoints reuse the client fixture default SUPERVISOR JWT from backend/tests/conftest.py; scenarios that assert role gating construct STAFF/SUPERVISOR tokens explicitly via v2._helpers.bearer.

Dates in Sales/Inward writes are computed relative to date.today() per the S3 IS-011/IS-012 lesson: the AC-021 7-day back-date guard rejects hard-coded 2026-06-05 fixtures once real time drifts past the window. Reports/Invoices use the same relative dates for consistency.
The Docker daemon requirement (INFRA-001) applies — testcontainers Postgres 16 is spun once per pytest session per conftest.py.

scenarios.title: DF-Auth: login → /auth/me → V1 protected endpoint round-trip through real HTTP
flow: Seed a SUPERVISOR user directly via UserModel (username='integ_admin', password='integ-pass-13', role='SUPERVISOR', is_active=True) using v2._helpers.seed_user
Use the unauthenticated_client fixture (no default Bearer header) so the login step is not shortcut by the conftest default JWT
STEP 1 — POST /api/v1/auth/login with application/x-www-form-urlencoded body (DS-024 / RFC 6749 §4.3.2): data={'username': 'integ_admin', 'password': 'integ-pass-13'}
• Expect 200 + TokenResponse: access_token (non-empty str), token_type='bearer', role='SUPERVISOR'
STEP 2 — GET /api/v1/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <token from step 1>
• Expect 200 + UserRead: id (int), username='integ_admin', role='SUPERVISOR', is_active=True
STEP 3 — GET /api/v1/suppliers with same Bearer token
• Expect 200 + list (empty since no supplier seeded — asserts the V1 endpoint is reachable through auth guard)
STEP 4 — repeat STEP 3 with no Authorization header
• Expect 401 + WWW-Authenticate: Bearer (per DS-025, superseding DS-005)
scenarios.exit_assertion: All 4 steps behave as specified. Step 1 returns 200 with a valid JWT that decodes to sub='integ_admin', role='SUPERVISOR'. Step 2 returns UserRead matching seed. Step 3 returns 200 (guard passes). Step 4 returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate header (guard rejects). Verifies that the DS-025 route-level Depends(get_current_user) applied on all 11 V1 routers is behaviourally equivalent to mount-level dependencies for legitimate and rejected requests.

scenarios.title: DF-Invoice: S2 sale → V2 invoice → V2 payments — full PENDING → PARTIAL → PAID lifecycle through HTTP
flow: Seed master (via v2._helpers): 1 design (D1='16X10 Ridges', size='16X10'), 1 grade (G1 code='1'), 1 active DesignGradeMap pair, 1 dealer, 1 staff
Compute sale_date = date.today() - timedelta(days=1) (within AC-021 7-day window)
STEP 1 — POST /api/v1/prices (SUPERVISOR — use default client fixture): {design_id:1, grade_id:1, unit_price:'150.00', effective_from: sale_date}. Expect 201 PriceMasterRead.

STEP 2 — POST /api/v1/sales: {sales_date: sale_date, dealer_id:1, place:'Mysuru', entered_by_staff_id:1, verified_by_staff_id:1, lines:[{design_id:1, grade_id:1, nos:10}]}. Capture sales_header_id from response.

STEP 3 — POST /api/v1/invoices?sales_header_id={captured_id}. Expect 201 InvoiceRead with total_amount == '1500.00', status='PENDING', 1 line with unit_price='150.00', quantity=10, line_total='1500.00'.
STEP 4 — POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments: {payment_date: today, amount:'600.00', notes:'first tranche'}. Expect 201; response status='PARTIAL'; payments length=1.
STEP 5 — GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}. Expect 200; status='PARTIAL'; total_amount='1500.00'; sum(payments.amount)=600.00.
STEP 6 — POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments: {payment_date: today, amount:'900.00'}. Expect 201; response status='PAID'; payments length=2.
STEP 7 — GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}. Expect 200; status='PAID'; sum(payments.amount)=1500.00.
STEP 8 — POST /api/v1/invoices?sales_header_id={captured_id} again. Expect 409 (duplicate — UNIQUE(sales_header_id) per DS-023).
STEP 9 — POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments: {amount:'1.00'}. Expect 422 (overpayment guard per TC-206).
scenarios.exit_assertion: Full lifecycle green. Expected transitions: create → PENDING; partial payment → PARTIAL; full payment → PAID. Snapshot invariant: invoice line unit_price equals PriceMaster unit_price at creation time. Duplicate create returns 409. Overpayment returns 422 (T-084 guard). All through real HTTP with SUPERVISOR default JWT — verifies M-002/M-011 composition and the full DS-022 + DS-023 contracts.

scenarios.title: DF-InwardReport: S2 inward writes → V2 GET /reports/inward with filters returns reconciled dual payload
flow: Seed master: 2 designs (D1='16X10 Ridges' 16X10, D2='12X8 Ridges' 12X8), 2 grades (G1 code='1', G2 code='2'), 4 active DesignGradeMap pairs, 2 suppliers (S1='Manjunatha' @ 'Mallur', S2='Ravi Traders' @ 'Bengaluru'), 1 staff
Compute inward_date_a = today - 1d, inward_date_b = today - 2d (both within AC-021 7-day window)

STEP 1 — POST /api/v1/inward: {purchase_date: inward_date_a, supplier_id:1, place:'Mallur', entered_by_staff_id:1, lines:[{design_id:1, grade_id:1, nos:20}, {design_id:1, grade_id:2, nos:10}]}. Expect 201.
STEP 2 — POST /api/v1/inward: {purchase_date: inward_date_a, supplier_id:1, place:'Mallur', entered_by_staff_id:1, lines:[{design_id:2, grade_id:1, nos:5}]}. Expect 201.

STEP 3 — POST /api/v1/inward: {purchase_date: inward_date_b, supplier_id:2, place:'Bengaluru', entered_by_staff_id:1, lines:[{design_id:1, grade_id:1, nos:15}]}. Expect 201.  ← will be excluded by supplier filter
STEP 4 — GET /api/v1/reports/inward?supplier_ids=1&places=Mallur (no date filter). Expect 200 with consolidation + transactions keys.
• transactions length=3 (2 lines from post 1 + 1 line from post 2)
• consolidation length=3: (D1,G1)=20, (D1,G2)=10, (D2,G1)=5
• sum(transactions.nos) == sum(consolidation.total_nos) == 35 (AC-050 mirror asserted in InwardReportService.generate per DS-017)
• Bengaluru inward from step 3 absent from both sections
• consolidation ordered by design_name ASC then grade_code ASC (RULE-019 mirror)
• transactions ordered by purchase_date ASC
STEP 5 — GET /api/v1/reports/inward (no filters). Expect 200; transactions length=4; consolidation sums to 50; Bengaluru row now present.
scenarios.exit_assertion: Filtered call (step 4) returns exactly 3 transactions + 3 consolidation groups with reconciliation sum 35 and correct sort. Unfiltered call (step 5) includes all 4 lines with reconciliation sum 50. Bengaluru inward is filtered out in step 4 but present in step 5 — proves the shared filter predicate (DS-017) applies uniformly to both sections and that no filter equals full dataset (RULE-018 mirror). Verifies M-002 write → M-009 read composition through the auth-guarded HTTP stack.

scenarios.title: DF-Export: Sales Report + Inward Report → GET /reports/{sales,inward}/export streams PDF and XLSX with correct magic bytes
flow: Seed master: 1 supplier, 1 dealer, 2 staff, 1 design, 1 grade, 1 active pair
POST /api/v1/inward with 1 line nos=25 (date=today-1d). Expect 201.
POST /api/v1/sales with 1 line nos=10 (date=today-1d). Expect 201.

STEP 1 — GET /api/v1/reports/sales/export?format=pdf. Expect 200. Content-Type = 'application/pdf'. Body starts with b'%PDF-' (PDF magic bytes). Content-Disposition contains 'attachment; filename=sales_report_' and '.pdf'.

STEP 2 — GET /api/v1/reports/sales/export?format=xlsx. Expect 200. Content-Type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'. Body starts with b'PK\x03\x04' (ZIP magic — XLSX is a ZIP archive). Content-Disposition contains 'sales_report_' and '.xlsx'.
STEP 3 — GET /api/v1/reports/inward/export?format=pdf. Expect 200 + PDF magic + filename 'inward_report_*.pdf'.

STEP 4 — GET /api/v1/reports/inward/export?format=xlsx. Expect 200 + XLSX magic + filename 'inward_report_*.xlsx'. Verify sheet names by opening with openpyxl.load_workbook(BytesIO(response.content)) — sheets ['Consolidation', 'Transactions'] present.
STEP 5 — GET /api/v1/reports/sales/export?format=csv. Expect 422 (Query pattern '^(pdf|xlsx)$' rejects unknown format at FastAPI validation layer).
scenarios.exit_assertion: Both formats stream successfully for both report types (4 successful exports). Magic-byte checks confirm actual binary content (not just a plausible content-type header). openpyxl round-trips the XLSX and sees both sheets (Consolidation + Transactions per T-086 spec). Invalid format returns 422 (route-level Query pattern), not 400 — this is FastAPI's validation layer rejecting before ReportExportService.export_* is called.

scenarios.title: DF-Users: SUPERVISOR creates STAFF → STAFF login → STAFF hits SUPERVISOR-only endpoint gets 403 → SUPERVISOR promotes STAFF → new token now succeeds
scenarios.entry_point: POST /api/v1/users → POST /api/v1/auth/login → POST /api/v1/prices (403) → PATCH /api/v1/users/{id} → login again → POST /api/v1/prices (201)
flow: Seed no user directly — use the default client fixture's SUPERVISOR JWT for admin steps.
Seed master (1 design, 1 grade, 1 pair) so the /prices POST payload is FK-valid.
STEP 1 — POST /api/v1/users: {username:'jane_staff', password:'staff-pass-01', role:'STAFF'} with default SUPERVISOR JWT. Expect 201; response role='STAFF'; capture user_id.
STEP 2 — POST /api/v1/auth/login (unauthenticated_client) form data={'username':'jane_staff','password':'staff-pass-01'}. Expect 200; role='STAFF'; capture staff_token.

STEP 3 — POST /api/v1/prices with Authorization: Bearer {staff_token} — body {design_id:1, grade_id:1, unit_price:'99.00', effective_from: today}. Expect 403 (require_supervisor rejects STAFF role per DS-019).
STEP 4 — PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_id}: {role:'SUPERVISOR'} with default SUPERVISOR JWT. Expect 200; response role='SUPERVISOR'.
STEP 5 — POST /api/v1/auth/login again for jane_staff. Expect 200; role='SUPERVISOR' in fresh token payload.
STEP 6 — POST /api/v1/prices with the FRESH jane_staff Bearer. Expect 201 (now allowed).
STEP 7 — DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id} with default SUPERVISOR JWT. Expect 204 (canonical soft-delete per DS-008).
STEP 8 — POST /api/v1/auth/login again for jane_staff. Expect 401 (account deactivated per AuthService.authenticate).
scenarios.exit_assertion: All 8 steps produce the expected status codes. Verifies the full user-management round trip: create → login → RBAC deny → role update → re-login → RBAC allow → soft-delete → login denied. Confirms that role changes take effect on subsequent tokens only (JWT is stateless) and that soft-deleted users cannot re-authenticate.

scenarios.title: DF-PriceSnapshot: PriceMaster unit_price change AFTER invoice creation does NOT mutate the invoice line unit_price (DS-022 immutability)
flow: Seed master: 1 design, 1 grade, 1 active pair, 1 dealer, 1 staff
sale_date = today - 1d
STEP 1 — POST /api/v1/prices: {design_id:1, grade_id:1, unit_price:'200.00', effective_from: sale_date}. Capture price_id.
STEP 2 — POST /api/v1/sales: 1 line nos=5. Capture sales_header_id.
STEP 3 — POST /api/v1/invoices?sales_header_id=captured. Expect 201; line[0].unit_price='200.00'; line_total='1000.00'; total_amount='1000.00'. Capture invoice_id.
STEP 4 — PATCH /api/v1/prices/{price_id}: {unit_price:'250.00'}. Expect 200; response.unit_price='250.00'.
STEP 5 — GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}. Expect 200; line[0].unit_price STILL '200.00'; line_total STILL '1000.00'; total_amount STILL '1000.00' — the PATCH did NOT bleed back into the invoice.
STEP 6 — GET /api/v1/prices. Assert the returned PriceMasterRead for (design_id=1, grade_id=1) shows unit_price='250.00' — the master itself did move, only the invoice_line snapshot is frozen.
scenarios.exit_assertion: Invoice line unit_price + line_total + header total_amount all remain at the values captured at invoice-creation time even after the master price is doubled. Confirms DS-022 snapshot immutability contract end-to-end — the invoice-line schema stores the price at the moment of invoicing, independent of subsequent PriceMaster edits. Guards against silent financial mutation.

execution_results.fix_root_cause: POST /prices returned 500 ResponseValidationError because PricingService.create_price returned raw PriceMasterModel while the router declares response_model=PriceMasterRead. PriceMasterRead requires flat design_name/size/grade_code, but these fields live on the joined design/grade relationships — pydantic from_attributes could not resolve them. The success path had never been exercised via HTTP by any V2 test.
execution_results.fix_summary: Added PricingService._to_read(price) → PriceMasterRead helper that flattens price.design.design_name, price.design.size, price.grade.grade_code (lazy='joined' relationships already load them). list_prices / create_price / update_price all return PriceMasterRead now. Follows the exact InvoiceService._to_invoice_read pattern.
